text.title: FreshDrop family box, offer test on 2 product pages, September 2026
text.hypothesis: families with children in Moscow need a weekly box, and the offer will attract at least 5% of visitors
text.audience: families in 3 Moscow districts: online ads and a shelf card in 2 shops
text.pack: a shelf card and a box insert with «Fixed slot, dinner on time»
text.action: clicks «Get the box» and leaves a phone number
text.threshold: strong at 4% or more; 3,000 views per variant needed
text.result: variant 1 converts 4.9%, variant 3 converts 2.0%; Moscow families beat the other groups
text.decision: test the box in 5 stores; drop the variant 3 offer
